arid_sandy.name: Arid / Hyper-Sandy Desert
arid_sandy.visual_markers: Pale tan to light brown coarse sand, loose granules, absence of vegetative cover, thermal shimmering.
fatal_limiting_factors: Rapid percolation (0 water retention)
Severe organic matter and micronutrient leaching
Scorching surface temperature (>45°C)
High alkalinity and boron toxicity

primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Permanently increases Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) and creates water retention sponges in coarse sand.

primary_remediation.amendment: Heavy Surface Mulch (Straw / Shredded Plant Matter)
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Reduces direct solar evaporation by 75% and suppresses soil surface heating.
Directly irrigates root zones via osmotic seepage with zero surface evaporation loss.

coastal_saline.name: Coastal / Saline / Sodic Soil
coastal_saline.visual_markers: Surface white crystalline efflorescence, hexagonal polygon cracking, dispersed grayish muddy sublayer.
fatal_limiting_factors: High Electrical Conductivity (EC > 6 dS/m) causing osmotic drought
Sodium ion (Na+) toxicity disrupting cellular potassium absorption
Dispersed soil structure choking root respiration
Chloride toxicity burning leaf margins

primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Calcium ions (Ca2+) displace toxic Sodium (Na+) from clay surfaces, allowing sodium to be leached downward.

primary_remediation.dosage: 100-150 liters per m² across raised beds
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Flushes displaced soluble sodium chloride below the root rhizosphere.
Prevents capillary rise of brackish saline groundwater into the topsoil.

acidic_clay.name: Acidic Tropical Clay (Laterite / Ultisol)
acidic_clay.visual_markers: Deep reddish-orange iron oxidation, sharp erosion gullies, dense blocky crusting, stunted shrub foliage.
fatal_limiting_factors: Soluble Aluminum (Al3+) and Manganese toxicity inhibiting root elongation
Severe chemical lockup of Phosphorus into insoluble Aluminum-Phosphate compounds
Heavy compaction causing waterlogging and anaerobic root conditions
Low base saturation (depleted calcium and magnesium)

primary_remediation.amendment: Agricultural Lime (Calcium Carbonate - CaCO3) or Dolomite
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Raises pH from 4.5 to 6.2, precipitating soluble toxic Al3+ into inert aluminum hydroxide.
Replenishes phosphorus in slow-release form; fungal hyphae bridge root absorption.
Breaks tight clay lattices, introducing micro-channels for oxygen and microbial aerobic life.

rocky_slope.name: Degraded / Eroded Rocky Mountainous Slope
rocky_slope.visual_markers: Shattered shale stones, loose gravel scree, thin skeletal brown dirt, steep gravitational slope.
fatal_limiting_factors: Shallow topsoil horizon unable to support taproots
Rapid torrential rainwater runoff and slope erosion
Intense diurnal temperature fluctuations and high UV index
Severe wind desiccation

primary_remediation.dosage: Swales dug along contour lines every 3m
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Harvests 90% of slope runoff and stops topsoil sediment loss.

primary_remediation.dosage: Planted along berm edges at 15cm spacing
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Dense massive 3m root system creates an underground living retaining wall.

primary_remediation.amendment: Compost Sheet Mulching & Soil Bladder Building
primary_remediation.dosage: 3 kg per m² of organic matter
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Artificially deepens the topsoil layer from 8cm to 25cm.

waterlogged_wetland.name: Waterlogged Silt Wetland / Peat Marsh
waterlogged_wetland.visual_markers: Standing dark water puddles, black saturated peat muck, anaerobic bubbles, reeds and marsh grasses.
fatal_limiting_factors: Complete root rhizosphere anoxia (zero dissolved oxygen)
Accumulation of toxic reduced compounds (H2S and methane)
Pythium and Phytophthora fungal root rot epidemics
Cold soil temperature retarding seed germination

primary_remediation.dosage: Ditches 40cm deep sloped toward retention pond
primary_remediation.scientific_rationale: Rapidly drops gravitational water table below active root zone.
Elevates root zone into aerobic atmospheric contact while drawing moisture from below.
Restores structural macro-pore spaces for gas exchange.

Cassava.why_viable: Immune to acidic soils and low phosphorus; massive root starch yield even in degraded soil.
Cassava.failure_mitigation: Requires well-drained mounds to prevent root rot in heavy rain.

Cowpea.why_viable: Yields protein-rich edible young leaves in 22 days; symbiotic rhizobia restore nitrogen to dead soil.
Cowpea.failure_mitigation: Harvest leaves selectively from outer branches to preserve pod development.

Pearl Millet.why_viable: C4 photosynthetic pathway allows high biomass production even at 45°C in hyper-arid sand.
Pearl Millet.failure_mitigation: Thin seedlings early to avoid intra-plant water competition.

Barley.why_viable: Highest salt tolerance of all major agricultural grains; excludes sodium at root tonoplast.
Barley.failure_mitigation: Must ensure adequate nitrogen and calcium to compete with sodium uptake.

Grain Amaranth.why_viable: Extremely fast growing; edible greens in 20 days; grain contains complete amino acid profile (high lysine).
Grain Amaranth.failure_mitigation: Protect tiny emerging seeds from heavy torrential washouts.

Swamp Taro.why_viable: Possesses internal aerenchyma tissue transporting atmospheric oxygen directly to submerged roots.
Swamp Taro.failure_mitigation: Must boil corms thoroughly prior to consumption to break down calcium oxalate crystals.

Sweet Potato.why_viable: Tolerates moderate soil acidity; shoots and leaves are edible within 25 days while tubers bulk underground.
Sweet Potato.failure_mitigation: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizers which cause lush leaf growth with zero tuber yield.

Tepary Beans.why_viable: Native to Sonoran desert; matures on a single rain soaking; highly protein dense.
Tepary Beans.failure_mitigation: Do not overwater during pod filling stage.

flood.action: Excavate emergency peripheral herringbone ditches (30cm depth) sloping toward external retention sump.
flood.triage: Starch tubers (Cassava/Potatoes) at critical risk of anaerobic soft rot; harvest immediately if tubers have bulked. Rice/Taro unaffected.
flood.remediation: Incorporate coarse horticultural sand into top 10cm and inoculate with Trichoderma viride to suppress fungal Pythium damping-off.

drought.action: Apply immediate 10cm dry straw or leaf-litter blanket mulch to arrest capillary evaporation.
drought.triage: Channel 100% of available water allocation to C4 cereal grains (Millet/Sorghum); prune 35% of lower legume foliage to minimize transpiration loss.
drought.remediation: Install unglazed earthen olla pots at 1m grid spacing for subsurface root zone osmotic irrigation.

pest.action: Deploy cold-pressed botanical neem extract oil solution (3% concentration) and establish controlled perimeter smudge woodsmoke fires.
pest.triage: Harvest all edible above-ground vegetative greens immediately for solar dehydration and sealed emergency storage.
pest.remediation: Intercrop companion perimeter barrier rows of Tagetes (marigold) and aromatic Allium to scramble pest olfactory receptors.

frost.action: Deploy temporary woven row cloches and execute light evening overhead sprinkler irrigation to release latent heat of fusion.
frost.triage: Cold-hardy cereals (Barley, Rye, Amaranth) survive down to -4°C; harvest all tender legume foliage prior to ground freezing.
frost.remediation: Mound 15cm compost mulch over plant crowns to insulate subterranean tubers from frost line penetration.

salinity_spike.action: Broadcast 500g/m² agricultural gypsum (CaSO4) immediately to saturate clay colloids with calcium.
salinity_spike.triage: Cease chemical fertilization immediately to prevent osmotic pressure spikes; isolate sensitive legumes.
salinity_spike.remediation: Flood beds with harvested non-saline rainwater to drive displaced sodium ions below the 40cm root horizon.
